items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: You played with him for quite a while. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Long years, huh? Long years is right.

ctx.x: It was difficult, because he was all the talk about over here. Oh, man. Something I found. That's all you could hear about. And you know I had made money with you plenty. You played with him for quite a while. Oh, yeah. Yeah. Long years, huh? Long years is right. Bring back members, huh, Harry?
Yes, ma'am, it does. I made money with me, too. That's right.
